title: 污染土壤氣相抽除
summary: 本課以「用真空、氣相通量與反彈證據判讀非飽和土壤氣相抽除」為主軸，依序處理污染概念模型與非飽和帶、含水率與氣相連通、質量移除與稀釋判別、尾氣處理介質突破、觀測網與證據缺口。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Interpret unsaturated-zone vapor extraction through vacuum, gas mass flux and rebound, progressing through Conceptual site model and vadose zone, Moisture and gas connectivity, Mass removal versus dilution, Off-gas media breakthrough, Monitoring network and evidence gaps. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

steps.title: 污染概念模型與非飽和帶：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Conceptual site model and vadose zone: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 污染概念模型與非飽和帶 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Conceptual site model and vadose zone and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先畫水位、透氣層、低滲透夾層與揮發源；氣相抽除依賴可連通的氣體孔隙，不能把飽和水體當成同一介質。 氣相孔隙體積除抽氣量是名目換氣尺度；含水增加同時會改變氣相連通性與滲透性。
steps.instructionEn: Map the water table, permeable layers, low-permeability lenses and volatile source; extraction relies on connected gas pores rather than treating saturated water identically. Air-filled pore volume divided by extraction flow gives a nominal exchange scale; rising moisture also changes connectivity and gas permeability.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：非飽和土體 V=500 m³；氣相孔隙率 na=0.20；抽氣 Q=50 m³/h。公式 t=V*na/Q，計算得 2 h。適用邊界：固定流量、均勻氣相，忽略壓縮性；不以較短名目時間推定較好整治。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Unsaturated bulk volume V=500 m³; air-filled porosity na=0.20; extraction Q=50 m³/h. Formula t=V*na/Q gives 2 h. Applicability: Fixed flow and uniform gas phase, neglecting compressibility; a shorter nominal time does not establish better remediation.
steps.failure: 水分上升可能令可抽氣孔隙變小卻加劇旁通。 在「污染概念模型與非飽和帶」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Rising moisture can reduce gas-filled pore volume while increasing bypass. Mark where this error can enter the Conceptual site model and vadose zone flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「污染概念模型與非飽和帶」，量土壤含水、各深度真空與氣體濃度，尋找被飽和水或低滲透層隔離區。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Conceptual site model and vadose zone, Measure moisture, vacuum and gas concentrations by depth to locate zones isolated by water or low-permeability strata. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.text: 只將 na 改成 0.10，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變成 1 h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。

steps.titleEn: Layered pilot extraction and flow allocation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 分層試抽與氣量配置 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Layered pilot extraction and flow allocation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 逐井比較氣流和真空回應，把快速吸入地表空氣的井與穿過污染區的井區分。 抽除質量率等於氣量乘濃度；稀釋可降低濃度而沒有提高污染物移除。
steps.instructionEn: Compare well-specific flow and vacuum, separating rapid surface-air intrusion from paths through contamination. Removal mass rate equals gas flow times concentration; dilution can lower concentration without increasing removal.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：抽氣 Q=80 m³/h；污染物 C=25 mg/m³；同一乾濕與溫壓基準。公式 m=Q*C/1000，計算得 2 g/h。適用邊界：準穩態且基準一致，不含管路冷凝或吸附損失。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Extraction Q=80 m³/h; pollutant C=25 mg/m³ on matching moisture, temperature and pressure bases. Formula m=Q*C/1000 gives 2 g/h. Applicability: Quasi-steady conditions and consistent bases, excluding line condensation and sorption losses.
steps.failure: 只以出口濃度降低判斷進度，可能把吸入清潔空氣視為整治。 在「分層試抽與氣量配置」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Concentration decline alone may mistake clean-air intrusion for remediation. Mark where this error can enter the Layered pilot extraction and flow allocation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「分層試抽與氣量配置」，同步記錄流量及分析濃度，積分質量率並核對處理單元前後負荷。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Layered pilot extraction and flow allocation, Record flow and concentration simultaneously, integrate mass rate and reconcile loads across off-gas treatment. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只將 Q 改成 120 m³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變成 3 g/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only Q to 120 m³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2 to 3 g/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
